notes: Bucket numbers stay on the cards. bucket_pools is the biome tag: cabinets credit the item's pool, not the delve you found it in. Each biome mix totals 10 (Weak/Tough/Deadly): b1 6/3/1, b2 5/3/2, b3 4/4/2, b4 3/5/2, b5 3/4/3. The pre-delve telegraph lists that biome's Deadly count. Later monster-entry loot still follows that monster's rank; only the opening six offers use starter_item_mix. The 3-unique start gate counts toward the Verdant Hollow cabinet of 5.
